notes: The first saying («يقوم في أمتي بعدي اثنا عشر أميراً») has its chain to Jabir ibn Samura, who heard the Prophet

The second part («فسألت القوم وسألت أبي ... فقال: قال: كلهم من قريش») is a second saying whose transmitter is the speaker's father, written without a name: rule 11 (two sayings in one report); not read as a route here
